summary_1line: Shurpanakha propositions Rama, is mockingly redirected to Lakshmana, then attacks Sita in jealousy, prompting Rama to order Lakshmana to punish her.

image_candidates.scene_text: The demoness Shurpanakha, eyes blazing like torches, lunges toward Sita beside the leaf-thatched hut while Rama reaches out to restrain her.
Shurpanakha, transformed and seductive, gazes passionately at Rama in the forest of Dandaka as he smiles and gestures toward Lakshmana.
Lakshmana stands smiling with ironic politeness as the lovestruck demoness eagerly approaches him under the forest canopy.
